unavailable_or_unclassified: An invariant shifted law is not its preparation or mixing across conserved residue sectors. The stated field energy is EXCESS mean energy, not total thermal energy. Upper-bounded arbitrary reciprocal prefactors do not even warrant native exclusion hydrodynamics at g=0. Retained records must preserve the complete future Markov interface. Weighted activity/field replacement under tilted histories is missing; naive path comparison has divergent kappa N^2 cost in the useful counter regime. Metric geometry separately changes the desired rare-density target.
